column2: I think a lot of Anti Nuclear Power is based off old designs that weren't as safe and had radioactive byproduct I think newer reactor designs take a lot of bite out of that process.  Additionally when you look at what is proposed to happen with Fusion reactors in Virginia in the next couple years it becomes a less popular position to be in opposition.
It's admirable they changed their stance but good Lord they are slow learners...
I've never understood the opposition to nuclear power. Was this a reaction to Chernobyl or did it start earlier?
I wish this happened decades ago because I'm not so sure fission can compete with renewables anymore given cost and time to build.

Why is war never a factor in the nuclear power debate? Like nuclear is great, until you have missiles dropping on your territory. You can ask Ukraine about that. Zaporizhia has been held hostage since the early days of the war. Should the Russians have a manic moment they can make a Chernobyl volume 2 with conventional explosives.

Nuclear is a great peacetime technology, Europe is no longer in peacetime.
